# pai plan

Run a planned job on local workers without a model in the loop

```
pai plan <command>
```

The scripted runner: a YAML plan of units and parts is executed by a loop that starts local workers, merges them with a gate and retries or flags failures. See docs/plan-runner.md.

```sh
pai plan validate plan.yaml
pai plan run plan.yaml --dry-run
pai plan status plan.yaml
```

### pai plan run

Run a plan: local workers in parallel, merged with the plan's gate

```
pai plan run PLAN [options]
```

Runs the parts of a plan on the local provider, no model in the loop: up to N parts at once, a part starts when its dependencies are merged and no running part shares a file, each finished part is merged with `pai worker merge --verify GATE`; a part whose worker branch holds no commit counts as no-commit, not merged, and goes down the failure ladder. The run is refused when the repo has uncommitted changes to files a part touches (--allow-dirty overrides). A failed part gets one local retry with the failure output appended, then is marked needs-decision while independent parts continue (with --escalate sonnet, one Sonnet worker runs instead). Progress is appended to PLAN.run.jsonl; running the same plan again skips merged parts. Exit codes: 0 all parts merged, 1 failures (needs-decision parts or failed unit checks) with everything else done, 3 blocked: nothing runs and every remaining part waits on a needs-decision item, so the run ends at once with a `blocked:` summary (run-end status blocked).

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PLAN` | yes | Plan file (YAML) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--parallel N` | number | — | Parts running at once (default: max_parallel of the plan, else the provider's maxConcurrent) |
| `--escalate TIER` | string | — | After the local retry, run one worker on TIER (only sonnet) instead of stopping at needs-decision |
| `--provider NAME` | string | — | Run the parts on this provider instead of the plan's (the value local is resolved at run start) |
| `--model MODEL` | string | — | Model the parts' workers get: default, fast or a model id (default: the provider's worker_model) |
| `--now` | flag | — | The parts' workers go ahead of the runs waiting for a slot on the provider |
| `--detach` | flag | — | Hand the run to a detached process that outlives this session and reports its events back to it |
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Print the schedule that would run; start nothing |
| `--allow-dirty` | flag | — | Run although the repo has uncommitted changes to files a part touches |

```sh
pai plan run plan.yaml
pai plan run plan.yaml --detach
pai plan run plan.yaml --dry-run
pai plan run plan.yaml --parallel 2 --escalate sonnet
```

See also: `pai plan validate`, `pai plan status`, `pai worker merge`

### pai plan validate

Check a plan file and list its parts

```
pai plan validate PLAN
```

Parses the plan and checks ids, dependencies (unknown parts, cycles), spec files and required fields. Exit 1 lists every problem.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PLAN` | yes | Plan file (YAML) |

```sh
pai plan validate plan.yaml
```

See also: `pai plan run`

### pai plan status

Summarise a plan's run log: done, running, waiting, needs-decision

```
pai plan status PLAN
```

Reads PLAN.run.jsonl and prints the parts per state, the tokens booked by finished workers and the wall time so far.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PLAN` | yes | Plan file (YAML) |

```sh
pai plan status plan.yaml
```

See also: `pai plan run`

### pai plan stop

Ask a running plan to stop after its in-flight parts

```
pai plan stop PLAN
```

Writes the stop marker next to the plan. The runner starts no new part once it sees it, lets the running parts finish and merge, and ends with run-end status stopped (exit 4). Merged parts are skipped by the next `pai plan run`. Refused when no run holds the plan.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PLAN` | yes | Plan file (YAML) |

```sh
pai plan stop plan.yaml
```

See also: `pai plan run`, `pai plan status`
